page.title: Inventory
page.description: What you have in stock and where. Running low puts it on the shopping list.

sections.lowDescription: At or below their minimum. They are on the shopping list for their usual shop.

fields.minQuantityDescription: At or below the minimum, the product goes on the shopping list.

form.description: How much of a product you keep at one place.
form.deleteDescription: The stock and its history at this place are removed. The product stays in the catalogue.

detail.placesDescription: Each place has its own quantity and minimum.

lowStock.addedToList: {{name}} is running low and is on the shopping list.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Point the camera at a barcode or one of your own QR labels.

hints.use: Scan something you are taking out of stock.
hints.add: Scan something you are putting away.
hints.identify: Scan anything to see what it is and where it is kept.

scan.chooseUse: Kept at more than one place. Where did you take it from?
scan.chooseAdd: Kept at more than one place. Where are you putting it?
scan.notKept: This product isn't kept in stock anywhere yet.
scan.unknownDescription: This code isn't in your catalogue yet. Add it as a product, then choose where you keep it.
scan.unknownChild: This code isn't in your catalogue yet. Ask an adult to add it.
scan.suggestedChild: This isn't in your catalogue yet. Ask an adult to add it.
scan.notFoundDescription: Fill in the details and add it as a product. Then choose where you keep it.
scan.whatNext: Saved. Where is it kept, or is it another brand of something you already have?

empty.title: Nothing in stock yet
empty.description: Keep track of the pantry, the freezer or the screws in the garage, and never run out.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.alreadyKept: This product is already kept at that place. Edit it there instead.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
